text:
Maya Chen: Quick flag  preview showed -14% for canary but billing sim ~+1%. Anyone seen sample-rate or warmup causing this?
Samir Patel: Yup. Two frequent diffs: preview defaults to full synthetic traces + fast warmup; billing uses sampled ingest + conservative cold profile.
Oliver King: We have two preview knobs (mode, cache_profile) but Console hides them. Example API: POST /api/cost_preview {"mode":"marginal","cache_profile":"fast"} to simulate warmed runs.
Maya Chen: If I flip to marginal+fast does it match billing?
Oliver King: Try it. If it aligns, discrepancy = warmup assumptions.
Maya Chen: Switched  now shows +0.9% which matches billing. Good catch.
Gina R.: Action items: 1) surface sample-rate in preview UI; 2) make amortized+conservative the default; 3) show a red warning banner when users pick marginal or fast profiles.
analytics-bot: Note created: AN-948 "preview vs billing parity: sampling & warmup"
Samir Patel: Also add a small tooltip explaining the 24h amortization default and link to docs.
Gina R.: I'll file PR and add unit tests that run preview with sampled traces.
Maya Chen: Thanks all 60a
